name: php
description:
PHP is compiled with default extensions. If you would like to use non-default extensions you can add them with devbox add php81Extensions.{extension} . For example, for the memcache extension you can do `devbox add php81Extensions.memcached`.

PHP-FPM listens on a unix socket rather than TCP (cf. the mariadb plugin's MYSQL_UNIX_PORT). Use $PHPFPM_UNIX_SOCKET to change the socket path; the default is .devbox/virtenv/php/php-fpm.sock. Note that unix socket paths are limited to ~107 characters.

Backward compatibility: if you set $PHPFPM_PORT (e.g. in the env block of devbox.json), php-fpm listens on TCP 127.0.0.1:$PHPFPM_PORT instead of the unix socket, so external tools that connect to the port keep working.
